env.name: TIMELINE_D141J_VISIBILITY_CAPTURE
env.format: JSON object with a non-empty expectedOccurrenceId string of at most 256 characters
env.malformed: fail closed to the ordinary fixture path

enabled_lifecycle: existing collector is created and installed before the test body can mount/read
test body runs against the same page
snapshot is extracted and attached as d141j-visibility.json
existing fixture closes its one page

retention.empty: preserved as empty events, never promoted to a semantic pass
retention.capture_failure: retained as unavailable without preventing cleanup

production_behavior: unchanged when the env is absent or malformed
